slides.headline: The one ruling that decides which AI serves the military
Pentagon cut Anthropic from contracts
slides.body: Anthropic, maker of Claude AI, was removed from a Pentagon vendor list last year.

slides.headline: Judges said the ban was legal
slides.body: A federal appeals court ruled the Pentagon acted within its rights to exclude Anthropic.

slides.headline: Safety rules clashed with military needs
slides.body: Anthropic's strict usage policies prevented its AI from being used in defense applications.

slides.headline: Government now picks AI winners
slides.body: This precedent lets agencies favor companies willing to relax safety guards for contracts.

slides.headline: AI policy affects your tools
slides.body: Follow for plain-English AI news that changes what you can use.
